jurisdiction.venue: Directorate of Enforcement (ED), Bengaluru Zonal Office (PMLA, 2002)

headline: India’s E.D. Attaches ₹702.7 Crore in Ozone Urbana Assets Over Alleged ₹1,305 Crore Homebuyer Diversion
deck: The Bengaluru Zonal Office’s second provisional attachment order lifts total frozen Ozone Group assets to ₹1,126.07 crore after investigators alleged housing loans and subvention-plan deposits were routed into inter-corporate debt service instead of apartments.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: India’s Enforcement Directorate provisionally attached ₹702.70 crore in land and flats tied to Ozone Urbana Infra Developers and chairman-managing director Vasudevan S, bringing total attachments to ₹1,126.07 crore in an ongoing probe alleging ₹1,305.11 crore in undelivered homebuyer funds were diverted across group entities.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Taking full upfront mortgage payments from hundreds of families for apartments with a promise to cover their bank installments until move-in day, then using the construction kitty to pay off older creditors
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Mandatory multi-year imprisonment under India’s Prevention of Money Laundering Act upon adjudication and conviction; all allegations remain under investigation

sources.title: Press Release: ED Bengaluru Provisionally Attaches Immovable Properties Worth Rs. 702.70 Crore in M/s Ozone Urbana Infra Developers Pvt. Ltd. & Others (PAO No. 45 of 2026)

interactive_art_spec.caption: Attara Kacheri, seat of the High Court of Karnataka in Bengaluru. The Enforcement Directorate’s Bengaluru Zonal Office provisionally attached ₹702.70 crore in Ozone Group flats and land under PMLA Provisional Attachment Order No. 45 of 2026.
